title: 4 Mathematics KCPE 2006
text:
THE KENYA NATONAL EXAMINATION COUNCIL
 KCPE 2006
 MATHEMATICS Time:2 hours
 READ THESE INSTRUCTIONS CAREFULLY
 1. You have been given this question booklet and a separate answer sheet. The question booklet
 contains 50 question
 2. Do any necessary rough work in this booklet
 3. When you have chosen your answer, mark it on the ANSWER SHEET, not in this question
 booklet.
 HOW TO USE THE ANSWER SHEET
 4. Use only an ordinary pencil.
 5. Make sure that you have written on the answer sheet:
 YOUR INDEX NUMBER
 YOUR NAME
 NAME OF YOUR SCHOOL
 6. By drawing a dark line inside the correct numbered boxes mark your full Index Number (i.e
 School Code and three-figure Candidate’s Number) in the grid near the top of the answer sheet
 7. Dot not make any marks outside the boxes
 8. Keep the answer sheet as clean as possible and not fold it.
 9. For each of the question 1-50 four answer are given. The answer are lettered A,B,C and D. In
 each case only ONE answer is correct .choose the correct answer.
 10. On the answer sheet the correct answer is to be shown by drawing a dark line inside the box in
 which the letter have chosen is written
 Example
 In the question booklet:
 11. What is the value of 6(24-18) +6× 4?
 A. 30
 B. 25
 C. 10
 D. 28
 The correct answer is c (10)
 On the answer sheet:
 1 [A] [B] [C] [D] 11 [A] [B] [C] [D] 21 [A] [B] [C] [D] 31 [A] [B] [C] [D]
 In the set, the box with letter D printed in it is marked.
 12. Your dark line MUST be within the box.
 13. For each question ONLY ONE box is to be marked in each set of four boxes
 The Kenya National Examination Council, 2006
 K.C.P.E MATHEMATICS 2006
 1. What is 73121025 written in words?
 A. Seven million three hundred and twelve thousands one hundred and twenty five.
 B. Seventy three million one hundred and twenty one thousand and twenty five
 C. Seven hundred and thirty one million two hundred and ten thousand and twenty five
 D. Seventy three million twelve thousand one hundred and twenty five
 2. What is 1.289778 correct to three decimal places?
 A. 1.2
 B. 1.289
 C. 1.29
 D. 1.290
 3. Mosi sold milk from 7th March 2006. For how many days altogether did he sell the milk?
 A. 58
 B. 59
 C. 60
 D. 61
 4. In the figure below lines PQ, RS and SQ have been constructed to meet a Q
 Measure angle SQR
 What is the size of angle SQR?
 A. 600
 B. 1140
 C. 1170
 D. 1290
 5. What is the sum of the total value of the digits in the hundreds and ten thousands positions in
 the number 693582?
 A. 95 000
 B. 90 000
 C. 10 100
 D. 9 500
 6. How many vertices does s triangular prism have?
 A. 2
 B. 5
 C. 6
 D. 9
 7. Sotse borrowed sh. 20, 000 from a money lender at a simple interest rate of 5% per month. How
 much money did he pay back altogether at the end of one year?
 A. Sh. 32,000
 B. Sh.21,000
 C. Sh. 20,000
 D. Sh. 12,000
 8. The height in centimeters of 10 pupils are given below:
 169, 173,158,170,171,159,180,167
 What is the mean height of the pupils?
 A. 159cm
 B. 166.9cm
 C. 168cm
 D. 1 669cm
 9. What is the next number in the parttern:
 1.2,2.4,4.8, ______?
 A. 6.0
 B. 7.2
 C. 8.4
 D. 9
 10. The decimals 0.09402,0.09024,0.09204 are to be written from the largest to the smallest. Which
 one of the following is the correct order?
 A. 0.09204,0.09402,0.09042,0.09024
 B. 0.09402,0.09042,0.09204,0.09024
 C. 0.09402,0.09042, 0.09042,0.09024,
 D. 0.09024,0.09042,0.9204,0.09402
 11. A rectangular plot of land measures 40m by 30m. There is a wall in one of the longer sides. Four
 strands of wire are to be used to fence the three remaining sides of the plot. What length of
 wire is required?
 A. 4,800m
 B. 560m
 C. 400m
 D. 100m
 12. In the year 2002 the number of pupils in a school was 800.In 2003 the number of pupils
 increased by 40%. How many pupils were there in 2003?
 A. 320
 B. 480
 C. 840
 D. 1,200
 13. A pupil intends to add the fractions 2/7,3/8 and 5/6. Which one of the following numbers should
 she choose as the least common denominator?
 A. 56
 B. 48
 C. 168
 D. 336
 14. Mukami had 135 two hundred shillings notes which she changed as follows:
 Sh. 21,000 into one thousand shillings notes
 Sh.3,000 into five hundred shillings notes
 Sh. 2,000 into one hundred shillings notes and the remaining amout of the money into fifty
 shillings notes.
 How many notes did she get altogether?
 A. 67
 B. 54
 C. 47
 D. 20
 15. A distance of 5 kilometers is represented on a map by a length of 4 centimetres. What is the
 scale used?
 A. 1:125
 B. 1:1 250
 C. 1: 12 500
 D. 1:125 000
 16. What is the value of 7(82 - 72 )+63 ÷7?
 A. 16
 B. 23
 C. 24
 D. 114
 17. What is the value of x in the equation
 1 ¼ x + 4 = 13 –x?
 A. 68
 B. 36
 C. 7 5/9
 D. 4
 18. Mula sold an item for sh. 9 900 and made a loss of 10%. What was the cost price of the item?
 A. Sh. 11 000
 B. Sh. 9 910
 C. Sh. 9 000
 D. Sh. 8 910
 19. Twenty litres of milk was given to a class of 50 pupils to share equally. How many deciliters of
 milk did each pupil get?
 A. 0.4
 B. 4
 C. 40
 D. 400
 20. What is the value of 0.6 -0.4 ×0.23-0.01?
 A. 0.0336
 B. 0.044
 C. 0.498
 D. 0.518
 21. A certain quadrilateral has the following properties:
 Has two sets of parallel sides
 Has all sides equal
 Diagonals bisect each other
 Some angles are equal
 Which quadrilateral has the above properties?
 A. Parallelogram
 B. Rhombus
 C. Square
 D. Trapezium
 22. An earoplane left town F at 22 30h on Monday. It took 8 ¾ hours to reach town K. When did it
 reach town K?
 A. Tuesday 7.15 a.m
 B. Tuesday 7.15 p.m
 C. Monday 7.15 a.m
 D. Monday 7.15 p.m
 23. What is the square root of 0.0576?
 A. 0.0024
 B. 0.024
 C. 0.24
 D. 2.4
 24. What is the volume, in cm3 of a cylinder whose diameter is 14cm and a height 10cm?
 (Take π 22/7)
 A. 6 160
 B. 1 540
 C. 748
 D. 440
 25. Mbogo and Kihara shared some of the money such that Mbogo got ¾ of the money shared out.
 What was the ratio of Mbogo’s share to that of Kihara?
 A. 4:3
 B. 3:1
 C. 3:4
 D. 1:3
 26. Onyango paid sh. 950 for an item after getting a discount of sh. 50. What percentage discount
 did he get?
 A. 5%
 B. 5 5/9%
 C. 5 5/19%
 D. 95%
 27. The figure below is part of a rhombus EFGH. Complete the rhombus.
 What is the length of half the longer diagonal?
 A. 4cm
 B. 3cm
 C. 6cm
 D. 8cm
 28. Samira bought the following items:
 Five half litres packets of milk @ sh. 30
 Two crates of soda 2 @ sh. 320
 Twenty five loaves of bread @ sh. 23
 A bottle of water for sh. 25
 If she had sh. 2 000, how much money did she remain with?
 A. Sh. 1 602
 B. Sh. 1 390
 C. Sh. 635
 D. Sh. 610
 29. The bar graph below shows the number of kilograms of sugar consumed by a school in five days.
 In which pair of consecutive days was the total consumption the heighest?
 A. Mon and Tue
 B. Tue and Wed
 C. Wed and Thursday
 D. Thur and Fri
 30. A youth group organized a film show to raise funds. Two hundred and eighty men attended the
 film show. The number of women who attended was half the number of men, while the number
 of youths was three times the number of both men and women. The charges were sh. Per adult
 and sh. 20 per youth. How much money was raised?
 A. Sh.46 200
 B. Sh.37 800
 C. Sh. 25 200
 D. Sh. 21 000
 31. In the figure below JK =JL=25cm and KM =ML.
 The perimeter of triangle JKL =98cm.
 K L
 What is the length of the perpendicular line JM in centimeters?
 A. 25
 B. 24
 C. 12
 D. 7
 32. Which one of the following expressions is equal to
 5(2a -3b) +5(a + 5b)
 3(4a -3b) +3 (a + 4b)?
 A. 15a + 10b
 15a +3b
 B. 5+ 25b
 6 +12b
 C. 15a +40b
 15a + 21b
 D. 15a +2b
 15a +b
 33. The following table shows the commission charged when one buys postal orders
 VALUE OF ORDER (sh) COMMISSION(sh)
 100.00 11.00
 200.00 12.00
 300.00 23.00
 400.00 39.00
 Wangechi wanted to send sh 700 by postal orders. Which one of the postal order combinations
 given below should she buy in order to pay the least commission?
 A. Sh. 400 + sh. 300
 B. Sh. 400 + sh.100 + sh.100 + sh. 100
 C. Sh. 300 +sh. 300 + sh.100
 D. Sh. 200 + sh. 200 +sh. 200 +sh. 100
 34. An open cylindrical tin of diameter 14cm and height 21cm was painted on the outside. What
 was the area paointed?( Take π 22/7)
 A. 3 234cm2
 B. 2 464cm2
 C. 1 232cm2
 D. 1 078cm2
 35. What is the value of r(p2 + qp) given that
 R +q
 R =6,p =r+2 and q-3?
 A. 56 8/11
 B. 38 6/11
 C. 30 6/11
 D. 20 4/5
 36. Asha and Musa are sells persons employed by two different companies. Asha’s company pays
 her a monthly salary of sh. 1 500 and 2 ½ % commission on goods she sells above 10,000.
 Musa’s company only gives 6% commission on all goods he sells. On a certain month Asha and
 Musa each sold goods worth sh. 40,000. How much more money was Musa paid than Asha?
 A. Sh. 2 400
 B. Sh. 2 250
 C. Sh. 900
 D. Sh. 150
 37. What is the value of 1 1/6 ÷1/4 ×2/3 + 5/8?
 A. 59/72
 B. 3 1/72
 C. 3 53/72
 D. 7 5/8
 38. A pick up whose mass is one tone when empty was loaded with 40bags of sugar each weighing
 50kg and three bags of maize each weighing 65kg. W hat was the total mass, in tonnes of the
 loaded pick-up?
 A. 3.195
 B. 3.065
 C. 3.0
 D. 2.195
 39. In a relay race Obong’o ran 600m, which is 2/5 of the race,in 3 minutes. Kyalo took 5 minutes to
 complete the race. What was the average speed for the whole race in m/s?
 A. 3
 B. 3 1/8
 C. 3 1/6
 D. 3 1/3
 40. Forty two men were hired to repair a stretch of road in 14 days. How many more men should be
 hired if the work was to be finished in 12 days?
 A. 6
 B. 7
 C. 49
 D. 91
 41. The number of women passengers in a bus was. The number of children in the bus was three
 times that of men passengers but was 6 more than that of women. Which one of the following
 expression shows the total number of passengers in the bus?
 A. 2 1/3 w +8
 B. 2 1/3 w -8
 C. 2 1/3 w +12
 D. 5w +24
 42. In the figure below linea AB,AC,BC and BD are equal. BDF and CDE are straight lines and angle
 ABD is right angle.
 B C
 What is the size of angle EDF?
 A. 300
 B. 450
 C. 600
 D. 750
 43. The graph below shows Muli’s journey from town X to town Y.
 What was the average speed, in km/h, for the whole journey?
 A. 72 ½
 B. 70
 C. 64 4/9
 D. 44 4/9
 44. On line YZ given below, complete the construction of the isosceles triangle XYZ where XY = XZ =8
 cm. Construct a circle centre O which touches the the side of the triangle.
 Y Y
 What is the radius of the circle?
 A. 2cm
 B. 3.6cm
 C. 4.3cm
 D. 5.4cm
 45. The hire purchase price for a wall cabinet is 25% more than the cash price. Kalulu bought the
 cabinet on hire purchase terms by paying a deposit of sh. 13, 200 and the remaining amount in
 12 equal monthly instalments?
 If the cash price was sh. 24,000, how was each monthly instalments?
 A. Sh. 400
 B. Sh.900
 C. Sh. 1,400
 D. Sh. 2,500
 46. A flower garden is made up of a semicircle of diameter 14m, a rectangle measuring 20metres
 long and 14 metres wide and a quarter of a circle of radius 14m. What is the area of the flower
 garden in m2 ? (Take π =22/7)
 A. 742
 B. 665
 C. 511
 D. 395 ½
 47. Kamau, Wasike and Omollo sell newspapers. One day Omollo sold 20 newspapers more than
 wasike who sold 10 newspapers more than Kamau. The total number of newspapers they sold
 that day was 140. If Wasike sold y newspapers, which one of the following newspapers sold by
 wasike?
 A. 3y +10 =140
 B. 3y +30 =140
 C. 3y +20 =140
 D. Y +30 =140
 48. Moraa shared money among her four children, Muta,Soma, Nduta and Aroya. Muta got 1/3 of
 the money while Somo got ½ of the remainder. The rest was shared equally between Nduta and
 Aroya. What fraction of the money did Ayoya get?
 A. 1/12
 B. 1/6
 C. 1/3
 D. ½
 49. A tailor had 17.5m of cloth material. From this material she made 2 dresses each requiring
 3.75m of material, and 3 jackets each requiring 2.4m of material. What length of material
 remained?
 A. 1.4m
 B. 2.8m
 C. 11.35m
 D. 14.7m
